result.summary: Removes trailing newline escape sequences from single-line log calls across the codebase using a scripted diff, excluding several high-churn files to minimize merge conflicts. It also removes embedded newlines from CTransaction::ToString, converting the transaction stringification used in debug logs into a single line.
result.problem: Log functions automatically strip a single trailing newline, but format strings ending in newlines falsely imply that explicit newline formatting is supported and require a special carve-out in log sanitization logic that escapes embedded newlines.
evidence: Author notes in PR description: 'After #35833 *embedded* newlines are escaped and a single trailing one is excluded. It would be clearer to not have a special carve-out here. Also the carve-out may be missing two-or-more trailing newlines.'
result.scope_notes: A scripted diff modifying 59 files via sed. Active files including src/init.cpp, src/net.cpp, src/net_processing.cpp, src/blockencodings.cpp, and src/netbase.cpp were explicitly excluded from the script to avoid conflicts.
result.changed_since_previous: Added commit fa885f4e0b to remove embedded newlines from CTransaction::ToString and updated CWallet::CommitTransaction accordingly. Excluded active network and init source files from the scripted diff, reducing the modified file count from 63 to 59.
result.card: Executes a scripted diff removing trailing newline escape sequences from single-line log calls across 59 files, alongside a manual commit converting CTransaction::ToString to a single line. The logging framework strips a single trailing newline, but retaining them in format strings creates unnecessary carve-outs when escaping embedded newlines and can fail if multiple trailing newlines are present. The author notes that removing trailing newlines simplifies sanitization logic introduced in PR 35833. There are no dependencies.

risk.why: The patch only touches log format strings and debug string output with no functional or algorithmic changes.
